professionalSummary: Senior Quality Operations Specialist with five years and two months of experience at a regional mobility operator, promoted from quality specialist after eighteen months.
Certified Lean Six Sigma Green Belt and ISO 9001:2015 internal auditor.
Led the partner quality audit programme covering about 900 driver and courier partners.
Responsible for audit sampling, case review, corrective‑action tracking and monthly reporting for the partner quality programme.
experienceHighlights: Senior Quality Operations Specialist for five years and two months at a regional mobility operator, promoted from quality specialist after the first eighteen months; led the partner quality audit programme covering about 900 driver and courier partners.

Ran the audit programme's quarterly sampling, the case review sessions with the partner managers and the corrective‑action tracker, closing actions with the regional managers within the agreed deadlines.
Prepared the monthly quality report for the operations director, covering audit results, open corrective actions and repeat findings; the director decided any partner suspensions.
projectsAndWorkSamples: Work sample: one quarter's audit sampling plan and corrective‑action tracker extract (partner id, finding, action, owner, due date, closure date) and the corresponding monthly report, with the tracker's change history as a verification trail.

They do not establish documentation of limitations or hand‑over conditions at the end of each audit cycle.
